audit.why: Lane difficulty 6/10 with a 48.61% win rate over 2191 games is consistent: Illaoi owns levels 1-5 in her tentacle field, Mordekaiser takes over at 6 with Realm of Death, and side lane returns to even.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart contradicted the packet chart and the whys text: rows 0, 3, 4, 5 and 6 were set to Skill/Illaoi where the packet says Illaoi, Illaoi, Mordekaiser, Skill, Skill.
audit.why: The packet levelChart and the existing whys ('Level 1 you out-body Morde', 'Through Levels 4-5 tentacle stacks out-damage his W shield', 'At Level 6 his R isolates you', 'trades even out') both describe the packet ordering. The chart rows disagreed with their own explanations.
audit.corrected: Flipped phases[0/3].side and win[0/3] to Illaoi, phases[4].side and win[4] to Mordekaiser, phases[5/6].side and win[5/6] to Skill, each as a matched full+content pair.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mordekaiser's W was written as 'Indignation' in spikes[2].text and wants.foe[1]. Riot's name is Indestructible.
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/mordekaiser.json gives W = Indestructible (stores damage dealt and taken as a shield, consumable as a heal). 'Indignation' is a fabricated name of the same class as the Brand/Cassiopeia errors in the calibration list.
audit.corrected: Renamed to Indestructible (W) and tied it to the Grievous Wounds requirement flagged in _missing (needs-antiheal). Also added Realm of Death's real 140/120/100s cooldown and Death's Grasp's 16s rank-1 cooldown so the sequencing advice is concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown advice was qualitative only ('when his R is down').
audit.why: Realm of Death is 140/120/100s and Death's Grasp is 16/14/12/10/8s; those numbers turn 'wait for it' into a two-minute window the player can actually count.
audit.corrected: Added 140s at rank 1 and 100s late to the spike text, and 16s at rank 1 for the E pull.

audit.why: Executioner's Calling is already listed in report[8]; the anti-heal need from _missing is real and is now also stated where the trade advice lives.
audit.corrected: Reinforced anti-heal in spikes[2].text and late.

audit.whatIsWrong: The _missing feed claims Obliterate (Q) denies Harsh Lesson (W) via grounding.
audit.why: Riot's description of Obliterate says only that it smashes the ground for damage, increased against a single target. The grounding flag is not supported by the description, and per the brief's own rule the description wins. I did not assert it.
audit.corrected: No text written about Q grounding; recorded in unverified.
sources: brief enemyKit Q description vs derived flag

edits.before: Before his ult you have the edge: W (Harsh Lesson) onto him and E (Test of Spirit) when his E (Death's Grasp) pull is down, and stacked tentacles out-damage his shield if you fight in them.
edits.after: Before his ult you have the edge: W (Harsh Lesson) onto him and E (Test of Spirit) when his Death's Grasp pull is down — it is 16s at rank 1, and stacked tentacles out-damage his shield.

edits.before: This is the danger — his R (Realm of Death) yanks you into an isolated 1v1 where your tentacles do minimal help and his ramping stat-steal shield lets him out-brawl you; avoid the all-in when his R is up.
edits.after: This is the danger — Realm of Death (R) drags you to a private 1v1 where your tentacles cannot follow and his stat-steal shield out-brawls you. It is 140s at rank 1: after he burns it you own the next two minutes.

edits.before: Roughly even: you re-slam under tentacles but he sustains through it with W (Indignation), so trades come down to whether he catches you with R off cooldown.
edits.after: Roughly even: you re-slam under tentacles but Indestructible (W) heals the chip back, so Executioner's Calling decides it — trades hinge on catching him with R down.

edits.before: The lane stays even into items — Morde tanks tentacle chip through his W shield and his R keeps flipping duels, so play around its cooldown and only all-in when Realm of Death is unavailable.
edits.after: The lane stays even into items — Indestructible (W) converts your tentacle chip into a heal, so keep Grievous Wounds up, and Realm of Death still flips duels: all-in only on its 100s late cooldown.

notes: Fabricated ability name 'Indignation' for Mordekaiser's W removed in two places (real name: Indestructible). Level chart was contradicting both the packet chart and its own whys text; all five disagreeing rows proposed as matched full+content pairs in one atomic group. Did not write the _missing claim that Obliterate (Q) grounds Harsh Lesson — Riot's description does not support the derived grounding flag.
